shell_commands: ls -la src/transport/*TestSupport* 2>/dev/null || echo "No ws test support files found"
npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && npm run eslint 2>&1 | grep -E "^(/|✖|src/transport/(conversationList|ws/(messageHandler|validation)))"

git add src/config.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): implement list_sessions handler with history support (#144)

- Add history.enabled config option to transport settings
- Implement list_sessions frame handler that responds with session_list
- Thread sessionStore and history options through createMessageHandler
- Convert Date objects to ISO strings for wire protocol
- Handle missing listFor gracefully (empty list response)
- Log and return SERVER_ERROR when listFor throws
- Extract shared test utilities (eventually, delegatingTo, cleanupConnectionsAndServers)
- Fix linting: remove duplicate code, restructure early returns, replace boolean flag

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

npm run eslint src/config.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts 2>&1

npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/config.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts 2>&1
